Marco & Sons Tiling — Berwick, VIC 3806

Twenty-six years on the tools. I did my apprenticeship in Reggio Calabria before we came out here
in '99, and I've been laying tile across the south-east ever since. My boy Dominic works with me
now and my nephew does the waterproofing. Three of us, one truck, no subbies. Every job I'm on
site myself.

HOW WE CHARGE

I'll be straight with you about this because it's where most tilers and most customers fall out.

I don't quote by the square metre. I never have. A square metre of tile in a straight run down a
hallway and a square metre of tile in a shower with three niches, a hob, a fall to the waste and a
mitred external corner are the same square metre on paper and they are not the same day's work, and
every time I've priced one off a floor plan I've either robbed myself or robbed the customer. So we
charge for our time, the way a cabinetmaker or a sparky does.

Our rate is $95 an hour for me, $75 an hour for Dominic, and we're usually both on site. Call it
$170 an hour for the pair of us, or $1,360 for an eight hour day. Waterproofing is my nephew and
he's $88 an hour.

Half day minimum. If we turn up and it's a two hour job you're still paying for the four, because
the four hours is what it costs me to not be somewhere else that morning.

WHAT THAT LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE

Because everybody asks, here's roughly how the jobs run out. These are NOT quotes, they're what
similar jobs have taken us:

A standard bathroom floor and walls — usually 4 to 6 days with the waterproofing.
An ensuite — 3 to 4 days.
A kitchen splashback — most of a day, sometimes two if there's a lot of cutting around power points.
A laundry — a day and a bit.
An open plan living floor — depends entirely on the size and the setout, could be 2 days, could be 9.
Outdoor alfresco — add a day for the falls.
A full house of porcelain — you're looking at a couple of weeks, but come and talk to me.

Herringbone, chevron, large format over 900, natural stone and anything mitred all take longer per
metre than a standard setout. Same rate, more hours. Mosaic is the slowest thing in tiling and I
won't pretend otherwise — a feature wall in a small glass mosaic can take two days on its own.

PREPARATION

Same rate. Surface preparation, floor grinding, priming, floor levelling, screeding and
adhesive removal are all charged at the hourly rate as part of the job. Levelling compound, primer, screed
sand and cement are charged at cost plus 10% and I'll show you the invoices.

Old tile removal is the same again — hourly, plus the tip fees, which run $90 to $140 a load
depending on where we take it.

WATERPROOFING

My nephew is fully licensed and we certify every wet area. Bathroom, ensuite, laundry, shower base,
balcony — all of it at his hourly rate plus membrane and materials at cost.

TILES

We don't sell tiles. Buy your own and have them on site before we start, plus 10% for cuts and
breakage. I'm happy to come to the tile shop with you and I don't charge for that — I'd rather
spend an hour there than have you buy something that won't work on your floor.

WHERE WE WORK

Berwick, Narre Warren, Beaconsfield, Officer, Pakenham, Clyde and around. Anything past about 40km
I'll ask for a bit toward the travel.

GST is included in the rates above.

I know the hourly thing puts some people off. All I can tell you is that in twenty-six years I've
never once had to go back to a customer mid-job and ask for more money, and that's more than most
of the per-metre mob can say.

— Marco
